newsitem.title: USA: Stocks end lower on profit-taking after recent gains.
newsitem.headline: Stocks end lower on profit-taking after recent gains.

text.p: Stocks lost ground Wednesday as investors called time out after the market's recent string of records and also on disappointment that Intel Corp. shares fell despite the company's very strong earnings.

The Dow Jones industrial average closed 35.41 points lower at 6,726.88 after posting four consecutive record highs. The Nasdaq Composite index was off 12.66 at 1,333.70. In the broader market, declining and advancing issues were even on heavy volume of 528 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
